feedback: Approved. The candidate is the iteration 9 design (score 929.76, the best raced so far) with one change: ki 0.02 to 0.10. Judged from earlier races only, nothing here is obviously broken: all values are inside the contract ranges, and kp 4.5, kd 1.0 and base_speed 1.1 match the settings that finished 60/60 in iterations 7 and 9. The integral is capped at +/-2, so ki 0.10 adds at most about 0.2 of turn. Iteration 7 showed rms_error of 0.0056 on the oval and 0.0162 on the s-bend, and that tracking term is the largest one the controller can still move. Its expected payoff is small, about 1 to 3 points, so the race is the real test. Iteration 8 showed that base_speed 1.2 cost slalom finishes (18/20, 2 off-track, score 908), so no speed change should be combined with this test. Read the race in this order: completion and progress on all three tracks, then slalom max_error (iteration 7 value 0.0233) and steering_oscillation (iteration 7 slalom 0.25), then rms_error. If the slalom completes less than 20/20, or slalom max_error passes about 0.035, resubmit the iteration 9 design with ki 0.02 for the final iteration, because the final track is unseen and robustness matters more than a few points. If all tracks finish and rms_error drops with max_error stable, keep ki 0.10 and consider a small kp rise to 4.8 as the next step, since iteration 4 showed kp 5.0 lowered s-bend rms (0.0166 to 0.013) but cost slalom progress. Line-loss events (one per run, about 105 points) have not moved under any gain, sensor or speed change in iterations 3 to 9, so this race should not be spent on them.
requested_changes: If the race completes 60/60 with slalom max_error at or below about 0.025 and rms_error lower than the iteration 7 values (oval 0.0056, s-bend 0.0162), keep ki 0.10 and test kp 4.8 with kd 1.0 and base_speed 1.1, since iteration 4 showed a modest kp rise lowered s-bend rms.

If slalom completion is below 20/20 or slalom max_error exceeds about 0.035, revert to ki 0.02 and resubmit the iteration 9 design (score 929.76) for the final iteration, because the final track is unseen.
Do not change base_speed above 1.1 (iteration 8 at 1.2 lost slalom finishes) or the sensor layout, and do not spend runs on line_loss, which has not responded to any change so far.
